sloka: राघवो अपि सह भ्रात्रा सह चैव हनूमता ।तदेव वनम् आगच्छत् सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥४-१२-२४॥
transliteration: rāghavo api saha bhrātrā saha caiva hanūmatā ।tadeva vanam āgacchat sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ॥4-12-24॥

translations.english: Rama together with Lakshmana and Hanuman also arrived at the same gave where Sugriva was.
